## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a Vercel runtime resolution issue where `@objectstack/metadata` was being resolved to `src/index.ts` instead of the compiled `dist/` output by aligning the package’s ESM/CJS metadata with the rest of the monorepo packages that work correctly on Vercel.

**Changes:**
- Added `"type": "module"` to `@objectstack/metadata` and updated `exports` to use the `.js` (ESM) / `.cjs` (CJS) pattern.
- Added a changelog entry documenting the Vercel `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` fix.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/metadata/package.json | Switches the package to ESM via `"type": "module"` and updates `exports` mappings to point to the correct compiled artifacts (`.js`/`.cjs`). |
| packages/metadata/CHANGELOG.md | Documents the runtime fix for Vercel module resolution. |

The inline code snippet in the changelog includes escaped quotes (`\"type\": \"module\"`), which will render the backslashes in Markdown. Use unescaped quotes inside the backticks so it displays as `"type": "module"` without backslashes in the rendered output.
